fields.description: Issue features editorials and reporting on alleged gambling and graft in Miami, including discussion of anonymous letters accusing officials and calls for grand jury action; coverage of Sheriff Jimmy Sullivan and Gov. Fuller Warren in the context of local politics and law enforcement; debate over bar and private-club curfew enforcement; municipal concerns including a proposed golf course swap involving Miami Springs; commentary on court and police matters and emergency medical care; and local events coverage including the Royal Poinciana Festival and Brickell Avenue poinciana blossoms. Includes syndicated/rewritten national material on lobbying and pressure groups in Washington and a digest of opinions of the Florida attorney general, along with advertisements and entertainment listings.
